description: Measures Tensor Core throughput (TOPS) using WMMA 16x16x16 tiles for a tiled GEMM (D = A * B + C). Tests FP16 via rocWMMA/nvcuda::wmma, and TF32 on NVIDIA Ampere+ (sm_80+). Emits per-iteration GPU event time and host time records (total = sum of kernel times); TOPS is derived downstream.

scaling_param.name: matrix_dim
scaling_param.description: Square matrix dimension M=N=K; must be a multiple of 16 (WMMA tile size)
